stories.title: Hot October inflation makes a December Fed rate hike look certain
stories.summary: US consumer prices rose faster than forecast in October. Traders now fully price a Fed rate increase on 9 December, and bitcoin slipped after the 8:30am ET release. Higher rates tend to weigh on assets like crypto that pay no interest.
points: Prices rose 0.4% in the month against a 0.3% forecast; core prices (without food and energy) rose 0.3% against 0.2%, per CoinDesk and BLS.
No yearly rate was published, because October 2025 prices were never collected during the government shutdown, per BLS.
Bitcoin fell about 1% to around $73,600 after the release and was near $74,200 at 10:18am ET, per CoinDesk.
After the data, CME FedWatch showed a December hike fully priced: 85% for a quarter-point and 15% for a half-point, per CoinDesk.
The 10-year Treasury yield rose 13 basis points to 4.99%, per CoinDesk.

stories.title: Bitcoin funds keep losing money as miners sell coins
stories.summary: US spot bitcoin funds had net outflows again on Monday, ether funds lost money too, and bitcoin was little changed while stocks rallied. Miners selling their bitcoin add to the supply hitting the market.
points: Monday 9 Nov: US spot bitcoin ETFs -$201M net, led by BlackRock's IBIT at -$213.2M, per CoinDesk.
Monday 9 Nov: US spot ether ETFs -$184.6M net, per CoinDesk.
Bitcoin fund outflows since 2 Nov total about $1.5B, per CoinDesk.
Miner MARA sold 13,597 BTC, about $1.1B, over six weeks, per CoinDesk.

sources.label: CoinDesk Daybook: ETF outflows mount, MARA sells

stories.title: MSCI decides Wednesday on Strategy; its bitcoin is now worth less than it paid
stories.summary: On Wednesday MSCI announces whether it will drop crypto-treasury companies like Strategy from its indexes, which could force index funds to sell the stock. Strategy kept buying bitcoin last week, but with bitcoin below its average cost its holdings are now under water on paper.
points: Strategy bought 1,036 BTC for $81.9M at an average of $79,012 each, per The Block.
It now holds 850,364 BTC bought for about $64.2B, an average of $75,456 each, per The Block.
With bitcoin near $74,650 when Blockhead published on Tuesday, those holdings were below cost, per Blockhead.
MSCI results come shortly after 11:00pm CET on Wed 11 Nov, with changes effective at the close on 30 Nov, per MSCI.

briefs.title: Coinbase, Kalshi and others back the CFTC in court
briefs.summary: They filed a brief supporting the CFTC's approval of single-stock perpetual futures, which a lawsuit is challenging, per crypto.news.

briefs.title: CME sues the CFTC over crypto perpetual futures
briefs.summary: CME wants the CFTC's approval of US crypto perpetual futures overturned, arguing they are swaps, per PiQ.

briefs.title: Binance hack money moves through NEAR memecoins
briefs.summary: Launderers linked to North Korea routed about $430K through six NEAR memecoins, per Elliptic via crypto.news.

briefs.title: Avalanche picked for NYSE tokenized platform
briefs.summary: The NYSE chose Avalanche for its planned 24/7 tokenized securities platform, and AVAX rose about 5%, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: Forced selling calms before CPI
briefs.summary: Liquidations fell about 84% to $184M in 24 hours, from more than $1B on Monday, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: Hyperliquid's HYPE well off its peak
briefs.summary: HYPE traded near $74.50, against a late-October peak of $96, per CoinDesk.
